data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for HTTP requests with cancellation and retry functions.
data.what_it_does: Provides helper functions for performing HTTP requests with built-in support for request cancellation using a CancellationToken, retries, and time limits. It acts as an extension wrapper around the standard http package.
use_when: You need simple HTTP requests with built-in retry mechanisms and cancellation support.
You want to add timeouts and cancellation tokens to basic http operations.
avoid_when: You need advanced networking features like interceptors, global transformers, or multipart uploading out of the box (use dio instead).
You require complex API abstractions (use retrofit).
You are working with GraphQL or WebSockets.
strengths: Supports cancellation tokens out of the box.
Easy to configure retries and timeouts for HTTP requests.
Compatible across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to fully-featured HTTP clients like dio.
Relies on basic wrapper logic around the core http package.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick dio if you need interceptors, global configuration, advanced file uploading, and a more feature-rich HTTP client.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick http if you only need the official baseline HTTP requests without added retry or cancellation helper abstractions.

alternatives.name: retrofit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick retrofit if you want type-safe REST API client generation using annotations.
